note: The corpus a MemoryStore is seeded from. Phase 1 has no ingested data, so these few entries are what the resolution ladder is tested against, and they are also the worked example a caller outside Wird copies to run jidhr with no database.

roots.note: No form of this root is attested in the entries below. It is here because the pattern rung answers only for a root the store confirms, so a corpus with no ordinary roots in it can only ever refuse — مالك needs م ل ك on record to resolve at all. It carries no transliteration on purpose: a root nobody has transliterated yet must ship the field absent rather than blank.

en.plain: To enjoin something on one another; to charge, counsel, bequeath.
en.poetic: A word handed on, the way a rope is passed from hand to hand.

ar.plain: أن يوصي بعضهم بعضاً؛ العهد والنصيحة.
ar.poetic: كلامٌ يُسلَّم كما يُسلَّم الحبل من يدٍ إلى يد.

en.plain: To be patient; to hold fast, endure, restrain oneself.
en.poetic: Patience is the rope, not the mood.

en.plain: To write; to prescribe, ordain, set down.
To program a machine; to draw up a schedule.
